d: Manchester United’s crisis is no longer just about results. After the 4-1 defeat to Como at the Champions League, captain Bruno Fernandes questioned Michael Carrick’s tactics, while the manager pointed to the team’s lack of effort and intensity. With United’s winless run stretching to seven games, the blame game has begun. Is this a captain demanding better or a dressing room losing faith in its manager? Rupha Ramani breaks down the growing rift at Manchester United.
